vrev_seq_lead: Quality and Semantic keep separate runs, decisions and histories. The sequence only links them.
vrev_seq_step_semantic: Semantic starts by itself only if Quality is complete, current, not reduced and approved.
vrev_seq_step_semantic_manual: Semantic waits for your advance after the Quality approval.
vrev_lead: See what will run, what stays out and what prevents the run, before running. The plan is built when the screen opens.
vrev_concurrency_many: Up to {n} at the same time
vrev_network_prep_none: No preparation step uses the network.
vrev_network_prep: The preparation uses the network for: {steps}.
vrev_network_policy_explicit: only the checks that declare it use it
vrev_network_needed: Needs the network ({count, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}}); {policy}
vrev_estimate_value: {time} (median of {runs, plural, one {# previous run} other {# previous runs}})
vrev_reduced: This validation will be reduced: something the profile asks for was turned off for this run only. The result does not count as approval of the whole profile.
vrev_uncovered_none: No requirement was left without coverage.
vrev_unavailable_title: Tools that will not be able to run
vrev_unavailable_lead: Each instance below is in the plan, but has no way to run right now. While this holds, the result stays incomplete and is never approved.
vrev_tie_explain: decisions of the layer {layer} with the same specificity disagreed, and the tie was resolved to on.
vrev_tie_decisions: {winner} won; against: {others}. On is the safe side: in a tie, more runs, never less. To decide differently, make one of the selectors more specific or remove one of them.
vrev_changes_title: What changed since the last plan
vrev_changes_first: This is the first plan of this workspace.
vrev_changes_same: Nothing changed since the last plan.
vrev_changes_network_off: The network is no longer necessary
vrev_terminal_lead: The command below runs exactly this validation and produces a plan with the same identifier.
vrev_command_copy_failed: Could not copy; select the command text.
vrev_effect_outputs: Writes outputs to the run folder
vrev_blocker_template: Required template without a compatible component
vrev_blocker_architecture: Architecture included without an active rule
vrev_blocker_build: The plan could not be built
vrev_unsaved_message: {count, plural, one {# document used by the plan has unsaved changes} other {# documents used by the plan have unsaved changes}}.
vrev_how_empty: Go back to Choose and leave at least one check on: choose another profile or undo the switch-offs of Customize this validation.
vrev_how_template: Add a component compatible with the template {template} (jgates.yml, components), or change its activation from always to detected or manual.
vrev_how_target: Go back to Choose and give the directory, the commit or the references of the target; the references must exist in this repository.
vrev_how_category: Turn on, in the profile or in the project, an executable check for each requirement, or undo the switch-offs of this run.
vrev_how_architecture: Declare at least one rule in .jgates/architecture.yml (Configuration, Architecture) and keep the architecture tool installed, or take architecture out of this profile.
vrev_how_config: Fix the indicated file in the tool editor (or save the valid draft) and build the plan again.
vrev_how_unsaved: Below, save each draft or choose to use the saved version; the plan only holds for one of them.
vrev_how_tool: Install the tool or point to its binary (jgates doctor shows what is missing and jgates tools prepare prepares what it can), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_version: Install a version within the adapter range (jgates doctor shows the range and the version found), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_eslint: Create an eslint.config in the component, or declare tools.eslint.config in .jgates/tools.yml pointing to the configuration file.
vrev_how_architecture_tool: Create .jgates/architecture.yml with at least one forbidden-dependency rule (or, in Python, keep a native Import Linter configuration), and install the tool.
vrev_how_tool_unavailable: Install the tool or point to its binary (jgates doctor shows what is missing), or turn the check off in the profile.
vrev_how_build: Check the message above, fix the configuration or the target and use Update plan.
vrev_how_network_denied: Allow the network in execution.network (jgates.yml) for the checks that ask for it, or turn those checks off.
vrev_caps_lead: Everything JGates knows how to check and what happens to each one in this project: what will run, what does not apply here (and how to turn it on) and what is off.
capst_blocked_detail: The profile requires it and nothing covers it: the validation is blocked.
capst_off_file: Off in this profile (by your file {file}).
capst_off_none: No profile turns this check on.
capst_reason_no_tool: JGates has no tool for this in this stack yet.
capst_reason_no_tool_for_languages: JGates has no tool for this in {languages} yet. It exists only for other languages: {tools}.
capst_reason_tool_missing: {tool} is not installed on this machine.
capst_reason_checks_disabled: The checks that would do this are off ({tools}).
capst_reason_evidence_missing: Only a custom command covers this, and it gives no evidence JGates can verify.
capst_reason_add_files: {tool} runs when the project has one of these files: {files}.
capst_reason_add_template: {tool} can run here: its template only has to be activated in jgates.yml.
capst_reason_configure: {tool} exists, but it is not configured in this project yet.
capst_template_unknown: The template {template} was not found in the catalog.
capst_need_project_profile: Starter profile: create a project profile to change this
capst_enabled_checks: Checks turned on in the profile {profile}.
capst_files_hint: After activating, create one of the files.
capst_turn_on_note: Saved in .jgates/profiles.yml; runs where a tool exists.
capst_turned_on: {name} turned on in the profile {profile}, where a tool exists.
capst_setting_target: the URL of the running target
capst_setting_url: the URL of the running target
vrev_na_requirements: Do not apply in this project
vrev_na_requirements_lead: On "where a tool exists", with no tool here (they do not block): {list}.
vrev_na_requirements_link: See the reason and how to turn each one on
capst_prepare_next: Then prepare {tool}: the tool is not installed on this machine either.
capst_setting_baseRef: the reference revision of the OpenAPI file
capst_prepare_running: Installing {tool}... this can take a few minutes.
capst_prepare_done: {tool} is ready; the plan was built again.
capst_prepare_result_done: {tool} is ready. The plan was built again.
capst_prepare_result_ready: {tool} is already available. The plan was built again.
capst_prepare_result_failed: The installation of {tool} did not work.
capst_prepare_manual: JGates cannot prepare {tool} by itself here: install it yourself, then build the plan again.
capst_prepare_manual_link: The "How to install" link has the official instructions.
vrev_prep_lead: What happens before the checks. Each step says how long it usually takes and which network it uses.
vrev_prep_sync: Copies the project into a Docker volume. Your files are not changed.
vrev_prep_net_services: with network: the compose services' images
vrev_prep_net_extension: with network: whatever the Dockerfile downloads
vrev_prep_deps_ready: The dependencies of {components} are already prepared and are reused.
vrev_prep_deps_first: Installs the dependencies of {components} (first time or a new lockfile).
vrev_prep_deps_first_estimate: a few minutes, this time only
vrev_prep_services: Starts the services {services} and waits until they are ready; they are shut down at the end.
vrev_prep_services_estimate: a few seconds to a few minutes
vrev_prep_extension: The own image changed and must be rebuilt before its tools run.
vrev_how_tool_missing: Download the tools of this JGates version; it is one download for every check.
vrev_tools_failed: The download did not finish. See the reason in Environment and try again.
capst_codeql_hint: In Environment you read the GitHub terms and accept them before preparing.
capst_services_hint: This check needs the project's services.
capst_reason_customer_supplied: {tool} is supplied by you and has not been prepared yet.
capst_reason_services_required: {tool} needs the project's services, which are not configured yet.
gtc_target_last_commit_hint: only what the last commit changed
gtc_target_changed_hint: only what changed compared to the base
gtc_target_compare_hint: what changed between two references of this repository
gtc_target_pr_hint: the branch of the pull request against the branch it merges into
gtc_last_commit_note: Compares HEAD~1 with HEAD: the files the last commit touched.
gtc_changed_no_base: There is no main branch here (main, master); choose the base above.
gtc_choose_ref: Choose a branch, tag or commit...
gtc_pr_base: Branch the pull request merges into
gtc_pr_required: Choose both branches of the pull request to continue.
gtc_pr_note: JGates does not ask GitHub: use the pull request's branch, already fetched, and the branch it merges into.
gtc_compare_note: Between two references of this repository: branches, tags or recent commits. Without the second one the working tree is used.
gtc_no_git: This folder is not a Git repository: only the full workspace and a folder can be validated.
gtc_default_note: Saves the gate and the target in jgates.yml, under selection; the next validations start from it.
gtc_default_not_saveable: This target does not become a default: it depends on commits, or on a folder not chosen yet.
gtn_title: {count, plural, one {What will not run (# check)} other {What will not run (# checks)}}
gtn_lead: Each check that stays out of this validation, with the reason and what you can do about it.
gtn_none: Everything the profile asks for will run.
gtn_kind_preparation_lead: The check is ready to run once its tool is prepared on this machine.
gtn_kind_configuration_lead: The check needs a setting, a file or a tool from you before it can run.
gtn_kind_not_applicable: Does not apply to this project
gtn_kind_not_applicable_lead: No tool covers it for the languages of this project; nothing to do.
gtn_kind_turned_off_lead: A profile, the project or this run turned it off.
gtn_job_failed: {name} did not finish. Try again, or open Environment for the details.
